description: For Companies other than companies claiming exemption under section 11. Used by domestic and foreign companies.

fields.name: Company PAN & Information
fields.description: Mandatory PAN, CIN (Corporate Identity Number), date of incorporation, nature of business.

fields.name: Shareholders' Information
fields.description: Details of the holding company, subsidiary company, key management personnel, and unlisted shares (if applicable).

fields.name: Balance Sheet (Part A-BS & Ind AS)
fields.description: Reserves, loans, fixed assets (tangible & intangible), current assets, liabilities as on 31st March. Schedule Ind AS if applicable.

fields.name: Manufacturing/Trading/P&L Account
fields.description: Operating revenues, expenses (employee cost, depreciation), direct taxes paid, and net accounting profit.

fields.name: Business Income Computation (Schedule BP)
fields.description: Deductions disallowed vs allowed under Income Tax rules (e.g., non-deduction of TDS, unpaid GST).

fields.name: Depreciation (Schedule DPM, DOA)
fields.description: Depreciation values allowable specifically for company properties as per IT Rules block rates.

fields.name: Other Income (Schedules HP, CG, OS)
fields.description: Rent from commercial/residential properties, capital gains on investments, dividends, interest.

fields.name: Minimum Alternate Tax (MAT) (Schedule MAT/MATC)
fields.description: Calculation of MAT at 15% of book profit if regular tax payable is lower.

fields.name: Audit Details (Part A-OI)
fields.description: Whether liable for tax audit u/s 44AB, Transfer Pricing audit, and details of the auditor.

fields.name: Final Tax & Verification (Part B-TTI)
fields.description: Total tax, surcharge, cess, advance tax paid, self-assessment tax, MAT credit, and authorized director signature.
